items.title: The Home Depot Announces Third Quarter Fiscal 2026 Results; Updates Fiscal 2026 Guidance
items.summary: The Home Depot®, the world's largest home improvement retailer, today reported sales of $43.4 billion for the third quarter of fiscal 2026, an increase of $2.0 billion, or 4.9% from the third quarter of fiscal 2025. Comparable sales for the third quarter of fiscal 2026 increased 2.2%, and comparable sales in the U.S. increased 2.2%.

items.title: The Home Depot Names Richard McPhail as CEO, Effective November 23, 2026
items.summary: The Home Depot®, the world's largest home improvement retailer, today announced that its board of directors has appointed Richard McPhail as chief executive officer and elected him to the company's board, effective November 23, 2026. Ann-Marie Campbell was named president and chief operating officer (COO), and Jordan Broggi was appointed executive vice president (EVP) and chief financial officer (CFO), also effective November 23.
